Your Story Starts Here.

Endless stories await on zeta. Explore new worlds and meet the characters who call them home. From sci-fi fantasy to adventure RPG and comedy, step into the lead role and shape the story your way.

“Predictable stories get old fast. On zeta, I can throw in the wildest plot twist whenever I want.”

■ Explore stories across genres

Follow a trail of clues through a rain-soaked city, set off with a wizard on his first adventure, or take the stage with a band whose lead singer just quit. Pick a world that sparks your curiosity and jump into the story.

■ Create your own characters and worlds

Bring a character from your imagination to life in just a few steps. Give them a name, a personality, and a short description, then start your journey.

■ Find your next line

Wondering what to say next? Tap Smart Reply for a suggestion. Use it to keep the scene going, or write a line of your own and take the story somewhere unexpected.

■ Privacy & Security

We care about your privacy and your chat experience. Personal information and conversation data are securely managed, and we continue improving zeta so users can enjoy the service with confidence.

Customer Support　https://support.zeta-ai.io
